menu.share_help: Scan the QR code or send the link so others can play.
rules.goal: Goal: you, the great-grandchild, must be born free of the 3 hereditary diseases.
rules.inherit: Everybody has two copies of each gene and passes one at random to each child. The diseases are recessive: two copies make you sick; with one you are a carrier (healthy, but you can pass it on).
rules.step1: Tap each frame of the tree and choose a great-grandparent. Every couple is a man and a woman.
rules.step2: Read the clues: nobody knows who is a carrier or who is sick.
rules.step3: Use your 4 tests: each one reveals one disease of one person.
rules.step4: Fill the 4 couples and press Be born!
rules.win: Win: healthy, but a carrier of something.
rules.risk: At the end you see your real risk: you can win with luck or lose with bad luck.
